question: Should this stay as the staged dashboard builtin task after the modular-dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract land, or should it be folded into a different canonical item?
rationale: Current main has the generic plugin-tab seam and coarse active-run flags, but not the dashboard plugin or the activity/attention contract this widget would consume; sequencing and ownership require maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Keep this issue open as the specific widget task, sequenced after the dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract are accepted.

options.title: Fold into activity contract first
options.body: Make the per-session activity issue own the state semantics and narrow this item to presentation after that contract lands.

options.title: Redirect outside bundled core
options.body: If maintainers do not want these bundled builtins, redirect the idea to an external plugin or ClawHub package after the widget SDK exists.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the specific widget task, sequenced after the dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about dashboard/product sequencing on top of the plugin-tab seam that steipete recently merged, while vincentkoc remains the key backend-contract reviewer.
